g.text: Mark: an eye whose iris is half filled with the signal colour: the share of a claim that holds up. Always with the
lowercase wordmark netra (Hanken Grotesk 600, tracking −0.04em). Mark alone for favicon and app icon.
Colour: ink #121212, paper #FBFAF7, one signal #E8590C, line #E6E2DA. No green (the colour of
greenwashing). Dark sections are reserved for proof (on-chain record).
Grades: A #1D4E89, B #3A6FB0, C #D9D4CB, D #F2A36B, E #B83A0E. Blue to orange, readable with colour
blindness; the letter is always printed on the swatch.
Type: Hanken Grotesk for everything (headlines 600, body 400, labels 600 caps with +0.08em tracking, tabular
numbers). Fragment Mono only for hashes and serial numbers.
Signature device: the claimed-vs-real bar. Outline = claimed, hatched = research range, filled = best estimate.
Use it wherever a claim is shown.
Layout: centred hero with one search box, generous white space, cards with 16 px radius and 1 px line borders.
